subject.title: fix: allow bailian provider in resolveThinkingProfile

question: Should OpenClaw accept custom `bailian` Qwen compat rows becoming reasoning-capable through generic configured-model inference, or defer that behavior to provider-owned Qwen/Coding Plan work?
rationale: The implementation is a plausible narrow slice, but it changes provider/model capability defaults for existing custom configs and the broader linked issue still needs vendor-proofed support boundaries.

options.title: Require Boundary Cleanup And Changed-Path Proof
options.body: Ask the contributor to remove the vLLM policy change, add focused configured-model coverage, and post redacted live proof for a Bailian Qwen row without explicit `reasoning`.

options.title: Accept Narrow Custom-Provider Default Change
options.body: Maintainers can accept the configured-model inference change as a supported custom-provider behavior once proof matches the changed path.

options.title: Defer To Qwen Provider Work
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the broader Qwen/Coding Plan provider-owned implementation to own all Bailian reasoning behavior.

recommendation.title: Require Boundary Cleanup And Changed-Path Proof
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to remove the vLLM policy change, add focused configured-model coverage, and post redacted live proof for a Bailian Qwen row without explicit `reasoning`.
